structure: A corpus of 103 Playwright trace zips of the GB notification service prototype's Design Release 2.1 (served under /design-release-2.1), recorded at Playwright 1.61.1 by the fit-style suite in workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/prototype-specs/e2e; all 103 tests passed, so no trace carries an error and the validation copy appears as rendered error states. index.json in the folder is the index: it maps each zip to its spec, test title, status and the pages (GET and POST) it visited. The traces come from 10 spec files: about-the-consignment (20 traces: notification type 3, origin of the import 4, what are you importing 5, germinal section 1 1, main import reason 7), address-book (9), consignment-parties (14: consignment addresses 7, add an address from the journey 2, add-address pages for the other roles 1, contact address 2, permanent address 2), dashboard (8), description-of-the-goods (7), documents (7), journeys (9: 4 notification-hub traces of 5 to 14 pages, and 5 end-to-end journeys of 48 to 58 pages and about 260 actions each), manage-notifications (7), templates (12, mostly 1 to 9 pages) and transport-and-arrival (10: add a transporter 4, arrival details 2, transit countries 1, transporter details 3); section traces run 1 to 43 pages and about 50 to 200 actions. The scope is every trace in the folder, so nothing is left out; the spec files themselves are a separate source (prototype:dr2-1-specs) and are named here only for their test titles. Cut into 16 parts along spec-file and describe seams in journey order: dashboard, the about-the-consignment describes in three parts, description of the goods, consignment parties in two, transport and arrival in two, documents, the hub, the five end-to-end journeys in two, manage notifications, templates, address book. The end-to-end journeys repeat pages the section parts also show; each part claims what its own traces render.
